name: GyroWand
summary: Raycasting for AR headsets driven by the orientation sensor of a handheld device, with the ray starting near the user's chin.
howItWorks: Inertial rotation data from a handheld controller steers a ray cast from a point below the head, so pointing works without external tracking of the hand position.
